decisions.reason: The conferencing service remains a low-cost option while demand uncertainty persists and no negative results have emerged.
The specific adoption in Hong Kong validated its value, and although no further traction is observed, the option remains valuable with low uncertainty.
The optical spectrum service builds on established strengths and holds strategic upside, but its reduced visibility raises some uncertainty.
The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost digital extension, but without new traction its option value is increasingly uncertain.
Direct voice network connection has not shown positive results after several years, and its unresolved value no longer justifies the option.
